title: Kiahdaj's Absolute Guide to Tulpas
author: Kiahdaj
edition_cited: Google Doc re-archived as PDF in archive.org item 'tulpamancy'; OCR text used
locator_hints: Section headed 'Imposition' and its sub-heading 'The process:' (near the end, before 'Possession:')
summary: A long general tulpa guide. Its imposition section is brief on method but useful as community consensus: imposition is described as the lengthiest part of the whole process and a luxury that many never complete; the author advises not starting visual imposition until the form is known so well that no detail varies; says prior open-eye visualizing helps; gives the baseline method as staring at a wall and picturing the figure overlapping the environment; notes that some find it easier in a dark room; and then defers to two forum guides by name (Marv and M's Starting Imposition Guide; q2's Method of a Huggable Tulpa) without reproducing them. It also debunks a claim that trained imposition can physically block the hand.
why_relevant: Thin on steps, but records the community's own estimate of difficulty, prerequisites and the two guides it treated as standard; a pointer source.

date_evidence.basis: archive.org stamps the item 'tulpamancy' addeddate 2020-04-14 (re-archived Google Doc); the text prints no date (searched for year strings). The guide refers to 'the IRC' and to the tulpa.info guide section, which suggests the early-to-mid 2010s, but that is not evidence.
